cloudflare-docs.probe: Search the Cloudflare documentation for Workers observability. Report the source URL and one relevant fact.

linear.probe: List accessible Linear teams. Report only whether the request succeeded and the count; do not print names or issue contents.

vercel.probe: List accessible Vercel projects. Report only whether the request succeeded and the count; do not print account or project identifiers.

cloudflare.probe: Use the Cloudflare search tool to locate the Workers observability API documentation. Do not call an API or execute code against an account. Report the documentation path only.

render.probe: List Render services in the selected workspace. Report only success and count. If no workspace is selected, stop and ask the user to select it; do not change workspace or any resource.

supabase.probe: List migration metadata for the selected development project. Report only success and count. Do not query table contents or mutate the database.

neon.probe: List accessible Neon projects. Report only success and count. Do not request connection strings, SQL data, or branch creation.
